requirements.title: Zone.String returns unique human-readable name
requirements.text: Zone.String() shall return a unique, non-empty, human-readable string for each defined Zone constant. Two distinct Zone constants shall never return the same string.

requirements.title: ZoneUnknown has value 0
requirements.text: ZoneUnknown shall have the numeric value 0, making it the zero value of the Zone type and a safe default for uninitialized variables.

requirements.title: ZoneFrontLeft has value 1
requirements.text: ZoneFrontLeft shall have the numeric value 1.

requirements.title: ZoneFrontRight has value 2
requirements.text: ZoneFrontRight shall have the numeric value 2.

requirements.title: ZoneRearLeft has value 3
requirements.text: ZoneRearLeft shall have the numeric value 3.

requirements.title: ZoneRearRight has value 4
requirements.text: ZoneRearRight shall have the numeric value 4.

requirements.title: ZoneCentral has value 5
requirements.text: ZoneCentral shall have the numeric value 5.

requirements.title: All named Zone constants are distinct
requirements.text: ZoneFrontLeft, ZoneFrontRight, ZoneRearLeft, ZoneRearRight, and ZoneCentral shall each have a different numeric value from every other named zone constant. Duplicate zone values would cause silent misrouting of commands.

requirements.title: PriorityNormal has value 0
requirements.text: PriorityNormal shall have the numeric value 0, making it the zero value of Priority and the safe default for Command fields left unset.

requirements.title: PriorityHigh is greater than PriorityNormal
requirements.text: The numeric value of PriorityHigh shall be strictly greater than PriorityNormal, enabling implementations to order commands by comparing Priority values directly.

requirements.title: PriorityCritical is greater than PriorityHigh
requirements.text: The numeric value of PriorityCritical shall be strictly greater than PriorityHigh, ensuring safety-critical commands (e.g. CmdWatchdog) can be unconditionally pre-empted above normal and high priority traffic.

requirements.title: CmdNoop has value 0
requirements.text: CmdNoop shall have the numeric value 0, making it the zero value of CommandType. An uninitialized Command.Type shall be interpreted as a safe no-op.

requirements.title: CmdSet has value 1
requirements.text: CmdSet shall have the numeric value 1.

requirements.title: CmdGet has value 2
requirements.text: CmdGet shall have the numeric value 2.

requirements.title: CmdReset has value 3
requirements.text: CmdReset shall have the numeric value 3.

requirements.title: CmdWatchdog has value 4
requirements.text: CmdWatchdog shall have the numeric value 4. The watchdog kick command shall be a stable, named constant so integrators can schedule it reliably.

requirements.title: All CommandType constants are distinct
requirements.text: CmdNoop, CmdSet, CmdGet, CmdReset, and CmdWatchdog shall each have a different numeric value. Duplicate command type values would cause a zone controller to misinterpret a command's intent.

requirements.title: ResponseStatus.String returns unique human-readable name
requirements.text: ResponseStatus.String() shall return a unique, non-empty, human-readable string for each defined ResponseStatus constant.

requirements.title: StatusOK has value 0
requirements.text: StatusOK shall have the numeric value 0, making it the zero value of ResponseStatus. An uninitialized Response.Status shall be interpreted as success.

requirements.title: StatusError has value 1
requirements.text: StatusError shall have the numeric value 1.

requirements.title: StatusTimeout has value 2
requirements.text: StatusTimeout shall have the numeric value 2.

requirements.title: StatusBusy has value 3
requirements.text: StatusBusy shall have the numeric value 3.

requirements.title: All ResponseStatus constants are distinct
requirements.text: StatusOK, StatusError, StatusTimeout, StatusBusy, and StatusUnknown shall each have a different numeric value. Duplicate values would cause a caller to misinterpret a command outcome.

requirements.title: ErrClosed is non-nil
requirements.text: The sentinel error ErrClosed shall be non-nil so that callers can distinguish it from a nil error return.

requirements.title: ErrNotFound is non-nil
requirements.text: The sentinel error ErrNotFound shall be non-nil.

requirements.title: ErrAlreadyExists is non-nil
requirements.text: The sentinel error ErrAlreadyExists shall be non-nil.

requirements.title: ErrTimeout is non-nil
requirements.text: The sentinel error ErrTimeout shall be non-nil.

requirements.title: ErrBusy is non-nil
requirements.text: The sentinel error ErrBusy shall be non-nil.

requirements.title: All sentinel errors are mutually distinct
requirements.text: ErrClosed, ErrNotFound, ErrAlreadyExists, ErrTimeout, and ErrBusy shall all be distinct error values such that errors.Is(errA, errB) returns false for any two different sentinels. Duplicate sentinels would prevent callers from distinguishing error causes.

requirements.title: ErrClosed detectable through wrapping chain
requirements.text: Any error returned by a closed Controller or Registry shall satisfy errors.Is(err, rcp.ErrClosed). Callers must be able to detect closed-entity conditions without parsing error strings.

requirements.title: ErrNotFound detectable through wrapping chain
requirements.text: Any error returned for a missing zone lookup shall satisfy errors.Is(err, rcp.ErrNotFound).

requirements.title: ErrAlreadyExists detectable through wrapping chain
requirements.text: Any error returned for a duplicate zone registration shall satisfy errors.Is(err, rcp.ErrAlreadyExists).

requirements.title: ErrTimeout detectable through wrapping chain
requirements.text: Any error returned due to a context deadline or cancellation shall satisfy errors.Is(err, rcp.ErrTimeout). This allows integrators to distinguish a transport timeout from a logic error.

requirements.title: Zero-value Command is a safe no-op
requirements.text: A zero-value Command (var cmd rcp.Command) shall have Zone=ZoneUnknown, Type=CmdNoop, and Priority=PriorityNormal. No field of a zero-value Command shall require explicit initialisation to avoid undefined behaviour.

requirements.title: Command.Payload may be nil
requirements.text: Command.Payload shall be an optional field; a nil Payload shall be accepted by any Controller.Send implementation without error or panic.

requirements.title: Response.CommandID echoes the originating Command.ID
requirements.text: Controller.Send shall return a Response whose CommandID field equals the ID field of the submitted Command. This allows the caller to correlate responses to commands in a pipelined command stream.

requirements.title: Response.Zone identifies the zone that processed the command
requirements.text: Controller.Send shall return a Response whose Zone field equals the Zone of the Controller that processed the command. A mismatch would indicate a misrouted command (safety goal SG-002).

requirements.title: Zero-value Response has StatusOK
requirements.text: A zero-value Response (var r rcp.Response) shall have Status=StatusOK (value 0). An uninitialised Response shall not indicate a spurious error.

requirements.title: Status.Zone identifies the publishing controller
requirements.text: Every Status published by a Controller shall carry a Zone field equal to the Controller's declared zone. A missing or wrong Zone would prevent the subscriber from identifying the source of the update.

requirements.title: Status.Seq is monotonically increasing
requirements.text: Each successive Status published by a given Controller instance shall have a Seq value strictly greater than the previous one. A subscriber can detect dropped or reordered updates by tracking Seq.

requirements.title: Status.Healthy is true while the controller is open
requirements.text: A Status published by a Controller that has not yet been closed shall carry Healthy=true.

requirements.title: Status.Payload carries the bytes passed to Publish
requirements.text: Status.Payload in every delivered Status update shall be byte-for-byte identical to the payload argument supplied to the Publish call that produced it.

requirements.title: Status.Payload may be nil
requirements.text: Publish shall accept a nil payload without error or panic. The resulting Status.Payload shall be nil.

requirements.title: Controller Send returns StatusOK with no handler
requirements.text: When no Handler is configured, Controller.Send shall return a non-nil Response with Status=StatusOK.

requirements.title: Controller Send dispatches to the configured handler
requirements.text: When a Handler is configured, Controller.Send shall invoke the handler exactly once per Send call and return the handler's Response verbatim.

requirements.title: Controller Send rejected after Close
requirements.text: Controller.Send called after Controller.Close shall return a non-nil error wrapping ErrClosed. No response shall be returned.

requirements.title: Controller Send respects a cancelled context
requirements.text: If the context passed to Controller.Send is already cancelled at call time, Send shall return a non-nil error wrapping ErrTimeout without invoking the handler.

requirements.title: Controller Close is idempotent
requirements.text: Controller.Close shall be safe to call multiple times. Every call after the first shall return nil without side effects.

requirements.title: Published Status is delivered to all active subscribers
requirements.text: A Status produced by Publish shall be received by every channel returned by an active Subscribe call on the same controller.

requirements.title: Subscribe channels are closed when the controller closes
requirements.text: When Controller.Close is called, all channels previously returned by Subscribe shall be closed. A subscriber ranging over a closed channel shall not block indefinitely.

requirements.title: Subscribe rejected after Close
requirements.text: Controller.Subscribe called after Controller.Close shall return a non-nil error wrapping ErrClosed. No channel shall be returned.

requirements.title: Controller.Zone returns the declared zone
requirements.text: Controller.Zone shall return the Zone value provided at construction time for the lifetime of the controller.

requirements.title: Subscribe Seq values are strictly increasing
requirements.text: Successive Status updates received on a Subscribe channel shall carry strictly increasing Seq values, enabling subscribers to detect gaps in the update stream.

requirements.title: Subscribe channel is closed when its context is cancelled
requirements.text: When the context passed to Subscribe is cancelled, the channel returned by that Subscribe call shall be closed. Other subscriber channels on the same controller shall be unaffected.

requirements.title: Multiple concurrent subscribers each receive published Status
requirements.text: When multiple Subscribe calls are active on the same controller, each returned channel shall independently receive every Status published via Publish.

requirements.title: CmdNoop is accepted without error
requirements.text: Controller.Send with Command.Type=CmdNoop shall return StatusOK and shall not return an error. The zero-value command type must always be safe to send.

requirements.title: CmdWatchdog is accepted without error
requirements.text: Controller.Send with Command.Type=CmdWatchdog shall return StatusOK and shall not return an error (safety goal SG-003: the watchdog kick command must be deliverable).

requirements.title: CmdReset is accepted without error
requirements.text: Controller.Send with Command.Type=CmdReset shall return StatusOK and shall not return an error.

requirements.title: Handler Response is returned verbatim
requirements.text: When a Handler is configured, the Response pointer returned by the handler shall be returned directly by Controller.Send without modification. The caller receives exactly what the handler produced.

requirements.title: Publish on a closed controller does not panic
requirements.text: Calling Publish on a controller after Controller.Close shall not panic. The call shall be a silent no-op; any pre-existing subscriber channels are already closed.

requirements.title: Concurrent Send calls are data-race free
requirements.text: Multiple concurrent calls to Controller.Send on the same controller shall be free of data races as detected by the Go race detector.

requirements.title: Concurrent Publish and Subscribe are data-race free
requirements.text: Concurrent calls to Publish and Subscribe on the same controller shall be free of data races as detected by the Go race detector.

requirements.title: Subscribe channel carries the correct Zone
requirements.text: Every Status received on a Subscribe channel shall carry a Zone field equal to the subscribing Controller's Zone (safety goal SG-002: zone identity must be preserved in all messages).

requirements.title: Subscribe channel carries correct Payload
requirements.text: Status.Payload on each received update shall be byte-for-byte identical to the payload argument of the Publish call that produced it.

requirements.title: Subscribe channel carries Healthy=true for open controller
requirements.text: Status.Healthy shall be true on every update published while the controller is open.

requirements.title: Cancelled context does not invoke handler
requirements.text: If the context passed to Send is already cancelled, the Handler shall not be invoked. A timed-out command must not silently trigger an actuator action.

requirements.title: Send with nil Payload does not panic
requirements.text: Controller.Send with Command.Payload=nil shall not panic. A nil payload is a valid command with no additional data.

requirements.title: NewRegistry pre-populates all five standard zones
requirements.text: A Registry returned by NewRegistry shall contain controllers for ZoneFrontLeft, ZoneFrontRight, ZoneRearLeft, ZoneRearRight, and ZoneCentral, all immediately accessible via Lookup.

requirements.title: Duplicate zone registration returns ErrAlreadyExists
requirements.text: Registry.Register for a zone that already has a registered controller shall return a non-nil error wrapping ErrAlreadyExists. The existing controller shall remain registered and unaffected.

requirements.title: Deregister removes the zone and closes its controller
requirements.text: Registry.Deregister shall remove the controller for the given zone from the registry and call Close on it. After deregistration, Lookup for the same zone shall return ErrNotFound.

requirements.title: Lookup returns ErrNotFound for an absent zone
requirements.text: Registry.Lookup for a zone with no registered controller shall return a non-nil error wrapping ErrNotFound.

requirements.title: Registry Close is idempotent
requirements.text: Registry.Close shall be safe to call multiple times. Every call after the first shall return nil without side effects.

requirements.title: Controllers returns all currently registered controllers
requirements.text: Registry.Controllers shall return exactly the set of controllers that are currently registered, with no duplicates and no omissions.

requirements.title: Register rejected after Registry Close
requirements.text: Registry.Register called after Registry.Close shall return a non-nil error wrapping ErrClosed.

requirements.title: Deregister returns ErrNotFound for a zone that was never registered
requirements.text: Registry.Deregister for a zone that has no registered controller shall return a non-nil error wrapping ErrNotFound, without modifying any other registered zone.

requirements.title: Registered controller is immediately retrievable via Lookup
requirements.text: After a successful Registry.Register call, Registry.Lookup for the same zone shall return the registered controller without error.

requirements.title: Registry Close calls Close on all registered controllers
requirements.text: Registry.Close shall call Close on every controller currently registered in the registry before returning. Controllers must not be left open after the registry is closed.

requirements.title: Lookup on a closed Registry returns an error
requirements.text: Registry.Lookup called after Registry.Close shall return a non-nil error. The caller must not receive a controller from a closed registry.

requirements.title: Deregister for an already-deregistered zone returns ErrNotFound
requirements.text: A second call to Registry.Deregister for a zone that was already deregistered shall return a non-nil error wrapping ErrNotFound.

requirements.title: ErrZoneMismatch is a distinct non-nil sentinel error
requirements.text: ErrZoneMismatch shall be a non-nil sentinel error that is distinct from all other sentinel errors (ErrClosed, ErrNotFound, ErrAlreadyExists, ErrTimeout, ErrBusy) so that callers can detect zone-misrouting without parsing error strings.

requirements.title: Controller.Send rejects commands whose zone does not match the controller zone
requirements.text: Controller.Send shall return a non-nil error wrapping ErrZoneMismatch when cmd.Zone does not equal the zone declared by the controller. A misrouted command must never be silently processed (safety goal SG-002).

requirements.title: Controller.Send copies Command.Payload before passing to the handler
requirements.text: Controller.Send shall copy Command.Payload into a new slice before invoking the handler. Subsequent modification of the original slice by the caller shall not affect the payload seen by the handler or any stored reference.

requirements.title: Controller.Publish copies the payload before embedding in Status
requirements.text: Controller.Publish shall copy the payload argument into a new slice before embedding it in the Status value delivered to subscribers. Subsequent modification of the original slice by the caller shall not affect the payload seen by any subscriber.

requirements.title: Registry.Lookup returns ErrClosed when called on a closed registry
requirements.text: Registry.Lookup called after Registry.Close shall return a non-nil error wrapping ErrClosed, not ErrNotFound. A caller polling on ErrNotFound must not loop indefinitely after the registry is closed.

requirements.title: Command latency bounded under GC pressure
requirements.text: The go-RCP mock controller shall deliver commands via Send with a maximum observed latency less than half the watchdog period (5 ms at 100 Hz) when measured under sustained 64 MiB/s GC allocation pressure. Evidence shall be recorded in safety/COMMAND_LATENCY.md.

requirements.title: UDP transport encodes and decodes Command frames correctly
requirements.text: The UDP transport shall encode a Command into a 16-byte header plus payload and decode an identical Command at the receiver. All fields (Zone, Type, Priority, ID, Payload) shall round-trip without loss.

requirements.title: UDP Controller routes Response to correct pending Send
requirements.text: The UDP Controller.readLoop shall match incoming Response frames to outstanding Send calls by CommandID and deliver them. Unmatched responses shall be silently discarded.

requirements.title: UDP transport encodes and decodes Response payload correctly
requirements.text: The UDP transport shall encode a Response payload into the wire frame and the receiving Controller shall decode an identical payload. Payload bytes shall survive the round-trip unmodified.

requirements.title: UDP Controller rejects zone-mismatched Send
requirements.text: Controller.Send shall return ErrZoneMismatch when cmd.Zone does not match the Controller's zone, consistent with REQ-CTRL-025.

requirements.title: UDP Controller.Send returns ErrTimeout on context expiry
requirements.text: Controller.Send shall return a non-nil error wrapping ErrTimeout when the provided context is cancelled or its deadline expires before a response is received.

requirements.title: UDP Controller.Send returns ErrClosed after Close
requirements.text: Controller.Send shall return a non-nil error wrapping ErrClosed when called after Controller.Close has been called.

requirements.title: UDP Subscribe receives Status published by ZoneServer
requirements.text: A Controller that has called Subscribe shall receive Status frames on the returned channel when the ZoneServer calls Publish. The Status Zone field shall match the controller's zone.

requirements.title: UDP ZoneServer fans out Status to all subscribers
requirements.text: When multiple Controllers have subscribed, a single ZoneServer.Publish call shall deliver one Status frame to every subscriber.

requirements.title: UDP Subscribe channel closes on context cancellation
requirements.text: The Status channel returned by Subscribe shall be closed when the subscriber's context is cancelled, allowing callers to range over it safely.

requirements.title: UDP Registry.Dial resolves address and registers controller
requirements.text: Registry.Dial shall resolve the server address, dial a Controller, and register it so that Registry.Lookup returns the same controller for the given zone.

requirements.title: UDP Registry.Dial returns ErrAlreadyExists on duplicate zone
requirements.text: A second Registry.Dial call for the same zone shall return a non-nil error wrapping ErrAlreadyExists and shall not replace the existing registration.

requirements.title: UDP Registry.Lookup returns ErrNotFound for unregistered zone
requirements.text: Registry.Lookup for a zone that has not been registered shall return a non-nil error wrapping ErrNotFound.

requirements.title: mDNS Transport delivers packets reliably on loopback
requirements.text: The mDNS Transport abstraction shall deliver any packet written by one endpoint to the other endpoint without loss or corruption on loopback interfaces used in testing.

requirements.title: Announcer.Announce emits a well-formed DNS-SD advertisement packet
requirements.text: Announcer.Announce shall write a DNS response packet containing at least one PTR record for _rcp._udp.local. onto the transport. The packet shall be at least 12 bytes.

requirements.title: Browser discovers a zone controller announced on the same bus
requirements.text: A Browser.Query call shall invoke the Handler callback with the correct Zone value when an Announcer on the same transport calls Announce.

requirements.title: Browser reports correct IP:port for discovered zone controller
requirements.text: The addr string passed to the Handler shall equal the IP:port originally provided to NewAnnouncer.

requirements.title: Browser stops reading when context is cancelled
requirements.text: Browser.Query shall return when the provided context is cancelled, without closing the underlying Transport.

requirements.title: Browser ignores non-response DNS packets
requirements.text: Browser.Query shall not invoke the Handler for packets that are DNS queries (QR bit = 0), avoiding false discovery from loopback query echoes.

requirements.title: Browser discovers multiple zone controllers from separate announcements
requirements.text: When N distinct Announcers send announcements onto the same transport, Browser.Query shall invoke the Handler N times with distinct Zone values.

requirements.title: Announcer.Close is idempotent
requirements.text: Calling Announcer.Close more than once shall not return an error on the second or subsequent calls.

requirements.title: TLS Controller Send/Response round-trip succeeds over mTLS
requirements.text: A Controller connected to a ZoneServer with mutual TLS shall successfully Send a Command and receive the corresponding Response with StatusOK.

requirements.title: TLS channel enforces mutual TLS authentication
requirements.text: Connections from clients that do not present a certificate signed by the server's trusted CA shall be rejected during the TLS handshake.

requirements.title: TLS server-side command handler is invoked for each Command
requirements.text: When a ZoneServer handler is installed via SetHandler, it shall be called for every Command received and its returned Response shall be sent to the client.

requirements.title: TLS command payload survives the stream framing round-trip
requirements.text: Payload bytes in a Command shall be identical to the bytes received in the corresponding Response payload echo, byte-for-byte, after passing through TLS framing.

requirements.title: TLS Controller.Send returns ErrZoneMismatch for wrong zone
requirements.text: Controller.Send shall return ErrZoneMismatch when cmd.Zone does not equal the Controller's zone, consistent with REQ-CTRL-025.

requirements.title: TLS Controller.Send returns ErrTimeout on cancelled context
requirements.text: Controller.Send shall return ErrTimeout when the provided context is cancelled before the send completes.

requirements.title: TLS Controller.Send returns ErrClosed after Close
requirements.text: Controller.Send shall return ErrClosed when called after Controller.Close has been called.

requirements.title: TLS Subscribe receives Status published by ZoneServer
requirements.text: A Controller that has called Subscribe shall receive Status frames on the returned channel when ZoneServer.Publish is called.

requirements.title: TLS Subscribe channel closes on context cancellation
requirements.text: The Status channel returned by Subscribe shall be closed when the subscriber's context is cancelled.

requirements.title: TLS minimum protocol version is TLS 1.3
requirements.text: Both ZoneServer and Controller shall negotiate TLS 1.3 or higher. Connections attempting to negotiate TLS 1.2 or lower shall be rejected.

requirements.title: Shmem Controller.Send delivers commands with StatusOK via shared bus
requirements.text: A Controller.Send over a shmem Bus shall receive a Response with StatusOK when no handler is installed, without serialisation or network I/O.

requirements.title: Shmem ZoneServer handler is invoked for each Command
requirements.text: When a handler is installed via ZoneServer.SetHandler, it shall be called for every Command and its Response shall be delivered to the sender.

requirements.title: Shmem Controller.Send copies payload before delivery
requirements.text: Controller.Send shall copy the Command payload into a pooled buffer before dispatching so that mutation of the original slice after Send does not affect the bytes seen by the handler.

requirements.title: Shmem Controller.Send returns ErrZoneMismatch for wrong zone
requirements.text: Controller.Send shall return ErrZoneMismatch when cmd.Zone does not match the bus zone, consistent with REQ-CTRL-025.

requirements.title: Shmem Controller.Send returns ErrTimeout on cancelled context
requirements.text: Controller.Send shall return ErrTimeout when the provided context is cancelled before the command is dispatched.

requirements.title: Shmem Subscribe receives Status published by ZoneServer
requirements.text: A Controller.Subscribe channel shall receive a Status frame each time ZoneServer.Publish is called while the subscription is active.

requirements.title: Shmem Subscribe channel closes on context cancellation
requirements.text: The Status channel returned by Subscribe shall be closed when the subscriber's context is cancelled.

requirements.title: Shmem Controller.Send is safe under concurrent callers
requirements.text: Multiple goroutines calling Controller.Send concurrently shall each receive a correct Response without data races or deadlocks.

requirements.title: LoaningController.Loan returns a zeroed buffer of the requested size
requirements.text: loan.Controller.Loan(size) shall return a *rcp.Loan whose Payload slice has length exactly size and all bytes equal to zero.

requirements.title: LoaningController.SendLoaned delivers the loaned payload via the inner controller
requirements.text: SendLoaned shall dispatch the command to the inner Controller.Send and return the Response. A StatusOK response shall be returned when no handler overrides it.

requirements.title: Loaned payload reaches the handler unmodified
requirements.text: Bytes written into a Loan.Payload before SendLoaned shall be byte-for-byte identical to the payload seen by the server-side command handler.

requirements.title: Loan.Return is safe to call and does not panic
requirements.text: Calling Loan.Return on any Loan obtained from LoaningController.Loan shall not panic and shall return the buffer to the pool.

requirements.title: LoaningController.Loan returns an error for negative size
requirements.text: loan.Controller.Loan(size) shall return a non-nil error when size is negative, rather than panicking or returning a nil Loan.

requirements.title: LoaningController.Send delegates to the inner controller
requirements.text: loan.Controller.Send shall delegate to the wrapped inner Controller.Send, preserving all error semantics including ErrZoneMismatch.

requirements.title: Default PCPMap maps priorities to correct IEEE 802.1p values
requirements.text: DefaultPCPMap shall return PCP=2 for PriorityNormal, PCP=5 for PriorityHigh, and PCP=7 for PriorityCritical, per IEEE 802.1Q-2022 Table I-1.

requirements.title: Controller.PCPFor returns the configured PCP for each priority
requirements.text: tsn.Controller.PCPFor shall return the PCP value from the TSNConfig.PCPMap corresponding to the given rcp.Priority value.

requirements.title: TSN Controller.Send delivers PriorityNormal commands successfully
requirements.text: tsn.Controller.Send with PriorityNormal shall receive a StatusOK Response from a ZoneServer over loopback UDP.

requirements.title: TSN Controller.Send delivers PriorityCritical commands successfully
requirements.text: tsn.Controller.Send with PriorityCritical shall receive a StatusOK Response, verifying that critical-priority commands are not dropped or demoted.

requirements.title: TSN Controller.Send returns ErrZoneMismatch for wrong zone
requirements.text: tsn.Controller.Send shall return ErrZoneMismatch when cmd.Zone does not match the controller's zone, consistent with REQ-CTRL-025.

requirements.title: TSNConfig VLAN and CycleNs are preserved and accessible
requirements.text: TSNConfig.VLAN and TSNConfig.CycleNs set during NewController shall be readable via Controller.Config() with the same values.

requirements.title: Token bucket refills at Config.Rate tokens per second
requirements.text: ratelimit.Controller shall refill its token bucket at Config.Rate tokens per second. After N seconds with no sends, the bucket shall contain min(N*Rate, Burst) additional tokens.

requirements.title: Bucket token count is capped at Config.Burst
requirements.text: ratelimit.Controller shall cap the token bucket at Config.Burst. Accumulated tokens from refill shall never exceed Burst regardless of elapsed time.

requirements.title: Send returns rcp.ErrBusy immediately when bucket is exhausted
requirements.text: ratelimit.Controller.Send shall return an error wrapping rcp.ErrBusy immediately (without blocking) when the token bucket contains fewer than one token. No command shall be forwarded to the inner controller on an ErrBusy return.

requirements.title: PriorityCritical commands bypass the bucket when ExemptCritical is true
requirements.text: When Config.ExemptCritical is true, ratelimit.Controller shall forward PriorityCritical commands to the inner controller without consuming a token and without returning ErrBusy. When ExemptCritical is false, PriorityCritical commands are subject to the same bucket check as all other priorities.

requirements.title: Zone() and Subscribe() delegate to the inner controller
requirements.text: ratelimit.Controller.Zone() shall return the inner controller's zone. ratelimit.Controller.Subscribe() shall delegate to and return the inner controller's Subscribe result.

requirements.title: Close() is idempotent and subsequent Sends return ErrClosed
requirements.text: ratelimit.Controller.Close() shall be safe to call multiple times and shall return nil on all calls. After Close(), Send shall return an error wrapping rcp.ErrClosed without forwarding to the inner controller.

requirements.title: Controller is safe for concurrent use
requirements.text: ratelimit.Controller shall be safe for concurrent use by multiple goroutines each calling Send simultaneously, without data races or incorrect token accounting.

requirements.title: Bucket starts full; DefaultConfig returns ASIL-B recommended values
requirements.text: A newly created ratelimit.Controller shall start with tokens equal to Config.Burst (bucket full). DefaultConfig() shall return a Config with positive Rate, positive Burst, and ExemptCritical=true.

requirements.title: Send returns StatusOK after simulated latency when not faulted
requirements.text: sim.Controller.Send shall sleep for BaseLatency (plus up to Jitter on LatencyJitter model) then return a Response with StatusOK when no fault is active. If ctx expires during latency, Send shall return rcp.ErrTimeout.

requirements.title: Fault() causes Send to return StatusError
requirements.text: After sim.Controller.Fault(err) is called, subsequent Send calls that complete their simulated latency shall return a Response with StatusError rather than StatusOK, simulating a failed zone controller.

requirements.title: Recover() clears the fault and restores StatusOK
requirements.text: sim.Controller.Recover() shall clear any active fault and clear the watchdog-missed flag. Subsequent Send calls shall return StatusOK again.

requirements.title: WatchdogMissed() returns true after WatchdogTimeout elapses without a kick
requirements.text: When Config.WatchdogTimeout > 0, sim.Controller.WatchdogMissed() shall return true if no CmdWatchdog command has been received within WatchdogTimeout of construction or the last kick.

requirements.title: CmdWatchdog resets the watchdog timer and clears WatchdogMissed
requirements.text: Sending a command with Type=CmdWatchdog shall reset the watchdog deadline timer and set WatchdogMissed() to false, allowing the next WatchdogTimeout window to begin fresh.

requirements.title: Status is published to subscribers at approximately Config.StatusInterval
requirements.text: When Config.StatusInterval > 0, sim.Controller shall publish a *rcp.Status to every active subscriber at approximately every StatusInterval. Subscribers shall receive at least one Status per two StatusInterval periods under normal operating conditions.

requirements.title: Subscriber channel closes on Close() or context cancellation
requirements.text: A channel returned by sim.Controller.Subscribe shall be closed when Controller.Close() is called or the subscriber's context is cancelled. Subscribe shall return rcp.ErrClosed if called after Close().

requirements.title: Close() is idempotent; DefaultConfig returns ASIL-B recommended values
requirements.text: sim.Controller.Close() shall be safe to call multiple times and shall return nil on all calls. DefaultConfig(zone) shall return a Config with positive BaseLatency, StatusInterval, and WatchdogTimeout.

requirements.title: FaultDrop returns an error without forwarding to the inner controller
requirements.text: A faultinject.Controller with a FaultDrop rule shall return an error from Send without calling inner.Send. The inner controller shall receive no commands during the fault window.

requirements.title: FaultSlow adds Rule.Latency before forwarding to the inner controller
requirements.text: A faultinject.Controller with a FaultSlow rule shall sleep Rule.Latency then forward the command to the inner controller. If ctx expires during the sleep, Send shall return rcp.ErrTimeout without calling inner.

requirements.title: FaultError returns StatusError without forwarding to the inner controller
requirements.text: A faultinject.Controller with a FaultError rule shall return a Response with StatusError from Send without calling inner.Send.

requirements.title: FaultTimeout returns rcp.ErrTimeout without forwarding to the inner controller
requirements.text: A faultinject.Controller with a FaultTimeout rule shall return rcp.ErrTimeout from Send without calling inner.Send and without blocking.

requirements.title: Count-limited rules auto-expire after N applications
requirements.text: A Rule with Count > 0 shall be automatically removed from the active rules list after it has been applied exactly Count times. Subsequent Sends shall proceed without that rule.

requirements.title: ClearRules() removes all active rules
requirements.text: faultinject.Controller.ClearRules() shall atomically remove all active fault rules. Subsequent Send calls shall go directly to the inner controller.

requirements.title: Controller is safe for concurrent use
requirements.text: faultinject.Controller shall be safe for concurrent use by multiple goroutines simultaneously calling Send, AddRule, or ClearRules, without data races.

requirements.title: Zone/Subscribe/Close delegate to inner; Close is idempotent
requirements.text: faultinject.Controller.Zone() and Subscribe() shall delegate to the inner controller. Close() shall close the inner controller and be safe to call multiple times. Subsequent Sends after Close return rcp.ErrClosed.

requirements.title: Allow entry permits exact principal/zone/cmd triple
requirements.text: authz.Policy.Evaluate shall return true for a (principal, zone, cmdType) triple that matches an Allow entry before any Deny entry in the ordered list.

requirements.title: Unmatched commands are denied by default
requirements.text: If no policy entry matches the (principal, zone, cmdType) triple, authz.Policy.Evaluate shall return false (default deny). An explicit Deny entry shall also return false.

requirements.title: Wildcard fields match any value in that dimension
requirements.text: An empty Principal shall match any caller. ZoneUnknown shall match any zone. CmdTypeAny (0xFFFF) shall match any CommandType. Wildcards enable broad permit/deny entries without enumerating every value.

requirements.title: Per-call principal override via context
requirements.text: authz.WithPrincipal shall embed a principal string in the context. authz.Controller.Send shall prefer the context principal over the static principal supplied at construction.

requirements.title: Policy entries may be replaced atomically
requirements.text: authz.Policy.SetEntries shall replace all entries in a single critical section so that concurrent Send calls see either the old set or the new set, never a partial mix.

requirements.title: Policy evaluation is safe under concurrent access
requirements.text: authz.Policy shall use a readers-writer lock so that concurrent Evaluate calls do not race with concurrent Allow/Deny/SetEntries calls.

requirements.title: Zone and Subscribe delegate to the inner controller
requirements.text: authz.Controller.Zone and authz.Controller.Subscribe shall delegate directly to the wrapped inner controller without applying policy checks.

requirements.title: Close is idempotent; Send after Close returns ErrClosed
requirements.text: Calling authz.Controller.Close more than once shall be safe and return nil. Any Send call after the first Close shall return rcp.ErrClosed without forwarding to the inner controller.

requirements.title: Update delivers image in chunks via CmdUpdate commands
requirements.text: firmware.Updater.Update shall split the image into ChunkSize-byte slices and send each as a CmdUpdate command with a ChunkPayload encoding the offset, total size, and CRC-32.

requirements.title: Chunks cover the full image with correct offsets
requirements.text: The sequence of ChunkPayload.Offset values shall be 0, ChunkSize, 2*ChunkSize, \u2026 covering every byte of the image without gaps or overlaps. The last chunk may be shorter than ChunkSize.

requirements.title: CRC-32 is embedded in every chunk payload
requirements.text: Every CmdUpdate payload shall carry the CRC-32/IEEE checksum of the complete image in ChunkPayload.CRC32 so the zone controller can detect corruption after the final chunk.

requirements.title: Zone controller rejection returns ErrZoneRejected
requirements.text: If any Send call during chunk delivery returns StatusError, Update shall return ErrZoneRejected immediately without sending further chunks.

requirements.title: Post-install CRC verification detects silent corruption
requirements.text: After delivering all chunks, Update shall send a verify CmdUpdate (offset == total size) and return ErrCRCMismatch if the zone controller returns StatusError.

requirements.title: Empty or oversized images are rejected before delivery
requirements.text: Update shall return ErrImageEmpty for a zero-length image and ErrImageTooLarge for an image exceeding MaxImageSize without sending any commands.

requirements.title: Concurrent updates on the same Updater are rejected
requirements.text: Only one Update call may be in progress on an Updater at a time. A second concurrent call shall return an error immediately without initiating delivery.

requirements.title: ChunkPayload marshals and unmarshals losslessly; DefaultConfig is valid
requirements.text: ChunkPayload.Marshal followed by UnmarshalChunkPayload shall reproduce the original TotalSize, Offset, CRC32, and Data fields exactly. DefaultConfig shall return ChunkSize > 0 and a valid Priority.

requirements.title: Broadcast delivers command to all group members concurrently
requirements.text: zonegroup.Group.Broadcast shall send the command to every member controller concurrently and wait for all responses before returning, achieving atomic multi-zone delivery within the context deadline.

requirements.title: cmd.Zone is overridden per member before Send
requirements.text: Broadcast shall set cmd.Zone to each member controller's Zone() value before calling Send, ensuring the command targets the correct zone regardless of the caller-supplied Zone field.

requirements.title: BroadcastResult.OK is false if any member fails
requirements.text: BroadcastResult.OK shall return false if any member returns a non-nil error or a Response with Status != StatusOK. All results are collected regardless of individual failures.

requirements.title: Context cancellation propagates to all member Sends
requirements.text: If the context passed to Broadcast is cancelled or times out, that same context is forwarded to each member Send call so all in-flight commands are cancelled simultaneously.

requirements.title: Zones and Len report the group membership
requirements.text: Group.Zones shall return the Zone() of each member in insertion order. Group.Len shall return the number of members.

requirements.title: NewGroup rejects empty or nil-member lists
requirements.text: NewGroup shall return an error if the member slice is empty or contains a nil controller, preventing construction of an invalid group.

requirements.title: Close is idempotent; Broadcast after Close returns ErrClosed
requirements.text: Group.Close shall close every member controller exactly once and be safe to call multiple times. Any Broadcast call after the first Close shall return rcp.ErrClosed.

requirements.title: Concurrent Broadcasts are race-free
requirements.text: Multiple goroutines may call Broadcast simultaneously on the same Group without data races. The Group's internal state is immutable after construction.

requirements.title: Proxy forwards commands to upstream transparently
requirements.text: proxy.Controller.Send shall forward the command to the upstream rcp.Controller and return the upstream response and error unchanged when no transform is set or the transform returns the command unmodified.

requirements.title: TransformFunc may rewrite the command before forwarding
requirements.text: If a TransformFunc is set, proxy.Controller.Send shall call it with the original command before forwarding. The returned command (which may differ from the input) is sent to the upstream controller.

requirements.title: TransformFunc error aborts the Send without reaching upstream
requirements.text: If TransformFunc returns a non-nil error, Send shall return that error immediately and not forward the command to the upstream controller.

requirements.title: Zone delegates to the upstream controller
requirements.text: proxy.Controller.Zone shall return the upstream controller's Zone() without modification.

requirements.title: Subscribe delegates to the upstream controller
requirements.text: proxy.Controller.Subscribe shall delegate to the upstream controller and return its channel and error unchanged.

requirements.title: Close is idempotent; Send after Close returns ErrClosed
requirements.text: Calling proxy.Controller.Close more than once is safe and returns nil. Any Send call after the first Close shall return rcp.ErrClosed without forwarding to upstream.

requirements.title: Concurrent Sends are race-free
requirements.text: Multiple goroutines may call Send simultaneously on the same proxy.Controller. The proxy's closed flag is accessed via atomic operations; the transform is called concurrently without internal locking.

requirements.title: Proxy is composable: a proxy may wrap another proxy
requirements.text: proxy.Controller implements rcp.Controller so it may be used as the upstream argument to a second proxy.NewController call, enabling multi-hop transformation chains.

requirements.title: Sends go to the primary controller when it is healthy
requirements.text: redundancy.Controller.Send shall forward commands to the primary controller and return its response when the primary returns no error.

requirements.title: Primary failure triggers failover to standby
requirements.text: When the primary controller returns a qualifying error, redundancy.Controller shall swap primary and standby atomically, increment the failover counter, and return the primary error to the caller. The next Send uses the former standby as the new primary.

requirements.title: Active returns the currently active controller
requirements.text: redundancy.Controller.Active shall return the controller that will be used for the next Send, reflecting any completed failovers.

requirements.title: FailoverPolicy may suppress failover
requirements.text: If a FailoverPolicy is provided and returns false for a given error, the controllers shall not be swapped and the error is returned without incrementing the failover counter.

requirements.title: Zone and Subscribe delegate to the active controller
requirements.text: redundancy.Controller.Zone and Subscribe shall delegate to whichever controller is currently primary, reflecting the post-failover state.

requirements.title: Close is idempotent; Send after Close returns ErrClosed
requirements.text: Close shall close both primary and standby controllers and be safe to call multiple times. Any Send after the first Close shall return rcp.ErrClosed.

requirements.title: Concurrent Sends are race-free during failover
requirements.text: Multiple goroutines may call Send simultaneously. The primary/standby swap is guarded by a mutex so that at most one goroutine triggers the swap and all subsequent Sends see the new primary.

requirements.title: Failovers counter reports the total number of primary swaps
requirements.text: redundancy.Controller.Failovers shall return the cumulative number of times the active controller has been swapped, enabling callers to detect repeated failovers.

requirements.title: Register claims exclusive zone ownership for an HPC
requirements.text: federation.Registry.Register shall associate zone with ctrl and return nil. If no other controller owns the zone, the registration succeeds.

requirements.title: Lookup returns the owning controller for a registered zone
requirements.text: federation.Registry.Lookup shall return the controller registered for zone. If no controller owns the zone, it shall return ErrNotOwned.

requirements.title: Registering an already-owned zone returns ErrAlreadyOwned
requirements.text: If zone is already registered to any controller, a subsequent Register call shall return ErrAlreadyOwned without modifying ownership.

requirements.title: Release removes zone ownership; releasing an unowned zone returns ErrNotOwned
requirements.text: federation.Registry.Release shall remove the zone from the registry. If the zone has no owner, Release shall return ErrNotOwned.

requirements.title: Zones and Owner report the current registry state
requirements.text: Zones shall return the set of all registered zones. Owner shall return the controller for a given zone, or nil if unowned.

requirements.title: TransferOwnership atomically reassigns a zone between HPCs
requirements.text: TransferOwnership shall atomically replace the owner of zone from the from controller to the to controller. If from does not own the zone, it shall return ErrNotOwned.

requirements.title: All Registry operations are race-free under concurrent access
requirements.text: Register, Release, Lookup, Owner, Zones, and TransferOwnership shall use a readers-writer lock ensuring no data race under concurrent read and write operations.

requirements.title: Multiple HPCs may own disjoint zone subsets in the same Registry
requirements.text: A federation.Registry shall support any number of HPC-controller pairs each owning a disjoint set of zones. Cross-HPC Lookup succeeds transparently.

requirements.title: OTel span per Send call
requirements.text: The observe.Controller shall create and end an OpenTelemetry trace span for every Send call, recording zone, command type, priority, and command ID as span attributes.

requirements.title: OTel span per Subscribe call
requirements.text: The observe.Controller shall create and end an OpenTelemetry trace span for every Subscribe call, recording the zone as a span attribute.

requirements.title: Send latency histogram
requirements.text: The observe.Controller shall call Metrics.ObserveSendLatency with the round-trip time in milliseconds for every successful Send.

requirements.title: Send error counter
requirements.text: The observe.Controller shall call Metrics.IncSendError for every Send that returns an error.

requirements.title: Zone health gauge
requirements.text: The observe.Controller shall call Metrics.SetZoneHealth after every successful Send, passing true when the response status is StatusOK.

requirements.title: Deadline miss counter
requirements.text: The observe.Controller shall call Metrics.IncDeadlineMiss when a Send error wraps context.DeadlineExceeded or rcp.ErrTimeout.

requirements.title: Send-after-Close returns ErrClosed
requirements.text: The observe.Controller shall return a wrapped rcp.ErrClosed error for any Send or Subscribe call made after Close.

requirements.title: Concurrent Send race-free
requirements.text: The observe.Controller shall be safe for concurrent Send and Subscribe calls without data races.

requirements.title: GET /zones lists all zones
requirements.text: The admin server shall return a JSON array of ZoneInfo for all registered zones on GET /zones.

requirements.title: GET /zones/{zone} returns zone detail
requirements.text: The admin server shall return a JSON ZoneInfo for a known zone on GET /zones/{zone}, and 404 for an unknown zone.

requirements.title: POST /zones/{zone}/send dispatches command
requirements.text: The admin server shall parse the JSON body, dispatch the command via the registry, and return the JSON response on POST /zones/{zone}/send.

requirements.title: Bearer auth on write endpoints
requirements.text: When BearerToken is configured, POST /zones/{zone}/send shall return 401 if the Authorization header does not match.

requirements.title: GET /events SSE stream
requirements.text: The admin server shall stream zone health events as Server-Sent Events on GET /events, one event per Flush boundary.

requirements.title: GET /metrics Prometheus format
requirements.text: The admin server shall emit zone health, command count, error count, and deadline miss count in Prometheus text format on GET /metrics.

requirements.title: RecordSend updates telemetry
requirements.text: The admin server shall update zone health, last-seen timestamp, error count, and deadline miss count when RecordSend is called.

requirements.title: Concurrent RecordSend race-free
requirements.text: The admin server shall be safe for concurrent RecordSend and HTTP handler invocations without data races.

requirements.title: RecordCommand appends command entry
requirements.text: The Recorder shall append a timestamped Entry of TypeCommand for every RecordCommand call, copying the payload to prevent aliasing.

requirements.title: RecordResponse appends response entry
requirements.text: The Recorder shall append a timestamped Entry of TypeResponse for every RecordResponse call.

requirements.title: RecordStatus appends status entry
requirements.text: The Recorder shall append a timestamped Entry of TypeStatus for every RecordStatus call.

requirements.title: Ring-buffer overwrites oldest entry
requirements.text: When maxEntries > 0, the Recorder shall overwrite the oldest entry when the buffer is full, preserving the most recent maxEntries entries.

requirements.title: WriteTo/ReadFrom binary round-trip
requirements.text: The Recorder shall serialise entries to a binary format with CRC-32 per frame via WriteTo, and ReadFrom shall deserialise them and return ErrCorrupted on checksum failure.

requirements.title: Controller records Send events
requirements.text: The record.Controller shall record the command before Send and the response after a successful Send.

requirements.title: Replay sends recorded commands
requirements.text: Replay shall re-send all TypeCommand entries to the target in order and return the collected responses.

requirements.title: Concurrent record race-free
requirements.text: The Recorder and record.Controller shall be safe for concurrent use from multiple goroutines without data races.

requirements.title: Load parses YAML config file
requirements.text: The config package shall parse a v1 YAML zone registry config file and return a validated File struct.

requirements.title: Load parses JSON config file
requirements.text: The config package shall parse a v1 JSON zone registry config file and return a validated File struct.

requirements.title: Decode detects format from extension
requirements.text: Decode shall use .yaml/.yml for YAML and .json for JSON; other extensions shall return an error.

requirements.title: ErrInvalidVersion on unsupported version
requirements.text: Load shall return a wrapped ErrInvalidVersion when the version field is not 1.

requirements.title: ErrDuplicateZone on repeated zone ID
requirements.text: Load shall return a wrapped ErrDuplicateZone when the same zone ID appears more than once in the zones list.

requirements.title: Watch calls onChange on initial load
requirements.text: Watch shall call onChange synchronously with the parsed config before returning.

requirements.title: Watcher.Reload hot-reloads config
requirements.text: Watcher.Reload shall re-parse the config file and call onChange with the new config.

requirements.title: Watcher.Stop terminates background goroutine
requirements.text: Watcher.Stop shall terminate the background goroutine without leak.

requirements.title: ParseManifest decodes YAML manifest
requirements.text: The codegen package shall decode a v1 YAML zone manifest and return a validated Manifest struct.

requirements.title: ParseManifest decodes JSON manifest
requirements.text: The codegen package shall decode a v1 JSON zone manifest and return a validated Manifest struct.

requirements.title: ErrInvalidVersion on bad version
requirements.text: ParseManifest shall return ErrInvalidVersion when the manifest version field is not 1.

requirements.title: ErrMissingPackage on empty package
requirements.text: ParseManifest shall return ErrMissingPackage when the package field is missing or empty.

requirements.title: Generate produces impl and test files
requirements.text: Generate shall produce one gofmt-formatted implementation file and one test skeleton file per zone in the manifest.

requirements.title: Generated impl contains fusa:req annotations
requirements.text: The generated implementation file shall contain //fusa:req annotations for all 8 zone requirements.

requirements.title: Generated test contains fusa:test annotations
requirements.text: The generated test skeleton shall contain //fusa:test annotations for all 8 zone requirements.

requirements.title: GenerateRequirements produces 8 reqs per zone
requirements.text: GenerateRequirements shall produce exactly 8 requirement entries per zone with correct ASIL and standard fields.

requirements.title: Schema registration
requirements.text: Registry.Register shall store a Schema by name and return ErrAlreadyRegistered if a schema with that name already exists.

requirements.title: Schema lookup miss
requirements.text: Registry.Lookup shall return ErrSchemaNotFound when no schema with the requested name is registered.

requirements.title: Schema retrieval
requirements.text: Registry.Lookup shall return the Schema previously stored by Register for the same name.

requirements.title: Payload encoding
requirements.text: Encode shall serialise a Payload to JSON bytes when all field values match the declared FieldKind and no unknown fields are present.

requirements.title: Payload decoding
requirements.text: Decode shall deserialise JSON bytes into a Payload map whose keys and values correspond to the original encoded data.

requirements.title: Field type enforcement
requirements.text: Encode shall return ErrFieldTypeMismatch when a Payload value's Go type is incompatible with the Field's declared FieldKind.

requirements.title: Unknown field rejection
requirements.text: Encode shall return ErrUnknownField when the Payload contains a key not declared in the Schema.

requirements.title: Typed send delegation
requirements.text: TypedController.SendTyped shall encode the Payload using the named registered Schema and delegate to the inner rcp.Controller.Send with the encoded bytes as Command.Payload.

requirements.title: gRPC server registration
requirements.text: RegisterServer shall register the Bridge gRPC service on a grpc.Server so remote clients can invoke Send and Subscribe RPCs.

requirements.title: Send RPC delivery
requirements.text: Controller.Send shall transmit a Command over gRPC and return the Response from the remote zone controller.

requirements.title: Zone mismatch rejection
requirements.text: Controller.Send shall return ErrZoneMismatch when cmd.Zone does not equal the Controller's zone.

requirements.title: Payload round-trip
requirements.text: Server.Send shall forward Command.Payload to the inner rcp.Controller unmodified and return the Response.Payload unchanged.

requirements.title: Subscribe streaming
requirements.text: Controller.Subscribe shall open a gRPC server-streaming RPC and deliver Status events received from the remote zone controller.

requirements.title: Idempotent close
requirements.text: Controller.Close shall be idempotent; repeated calls after the first shall return nil without error.

requirements.title: Closed send error
requirements.text: Controller.Send shall return ErrClosed after Controller.Close has been called.

requirements.title: Inner error propagation
requirements.text: Server.Send shall propagate the rcp.ResponseStatus from the inner controller in the SendResponse.

requirements.title: HTTP send endpoint
requirements.text: Server shall expose POST /v1/zones/{zone}/send to deliver a JSON-encoded Command to the inner rcp.Controller.

requirements.title: JSON response status
requirements.text: Server shall return a JSON SendResponse containing the CommandID, Zone, Status, and optional Payload fields.

requirements.title: Unknown zone rejection
requirements.text: Server shall return HTTP 422 Unprocessable Entity when the zone path parameter does not match a valid rcp.Zone.

requirements.title: SSE events endpoint
requirements.text: Server shall expose GET /v1/zones/{zone}/events as a Server-Sent Events stream delivering rcp.Status updates.

requirements.title: Controller HTTP send
requirements.text: Controller.Send shall POST the Command to the server and decode the JSON SendResponse into an rcp.Response.

requirements.title: Zone mismatch rejection
requirements.text: Controller.Send shall return ErrZoneMismatch when cmd.Zone does not equal the Controller's zone without making a network request.

requirements.title: Idempotent close
requirements.text: Controller.Close shall be idempotent; repeated calls after the first shall return nil without error.

requirements.title: Closed send error
requirements.text: Controller.Send shall return ErrClosed without making a network request after Controller.Close has been called.

requirements.title: SOME/IP header encoding
requirements.text: encodeFrame shall produce a 16-byte SOME/IP header with service ID, method ID, length, client ID, session ID, protocol/interface version, message type, and return code in big-endian byte order.

requirements.title: SOME/IP header decoding
requirements.text: decodeFrame shall parse a 16-byte SOME/IP header and return ErrMalformedFrame when the datagram is shorter than 16 bytes.

requirements.title: Server request dispatch
requirements.text: Server shall accept UDP SOME/IP REQUEST datagrams and dispatch the embedded command to the inner rcp.Controller.

requirements.title: Server RESPONSE reply
requirements.text: Server shall reply to each REQUEST with a SOME/IP RESPONSE datagram encoding the inner controller's ResponseStatus in the ReturnCode field.

requirements.title: Controller send encoding
requirements.text: Controller.Send shall encode the rcp.Command as a SOME/IP REQUEST datagram, correlate the RESPONSE by session ID, and decode the result into an rcp.Response.

requirements.title: Zone mismatch rejection
requirements.text: Controller.Send shall return ErrZoneMismatch when cmd.Zone does not equal the Controller's zone without sending a datagram.

requirements.title: Idempotent close
requirements.text: Controller.Close shall be idempotent; repeated calls after the first shall return nil without error.

requirements.title: Closed send error
requirements.text: Controller.Send shall return ErrClosed without sending a datagram after Controller.Close has been called.

requirements.title: CAN frame encoding
requirements.text: Frame.Encode shall produce a 13-byte wire representation with CANID (4 bytes big-endian), DLC (1 byte), and data (8 bytes).

requirements.title: CAN frame decoding
requirements.text: Decode shall parse a 13-byte buffer into a Frame and return ErrMalformedFrame when the buffer is shorter than 13 bytes.

requirements.title: Bus broadcast delivery
requirements.text: Bus.Send shall deliver a CAN frame to all active subscribers without blocking the sender.

requirements.title: Server frame dispatch
requirements.text: Server shall subscribe to the Bus and forward incoming REQUEST frames to the inner rcp.Controller with the frame ID mapped to rcp.CommandType.

requirements.title: Server response frame
requirements.text: Server shall publish a RESPONSE frame (request ID | 0x400) onto the Bus after the inner controller responds.

requirements.title: Controller frame send
requirements.text: Controller.Send shall publish a CAN REQUEST frame and correlate the matching RESPONSE frame by ID to produce an rcp.Response.

requirements.title: Idempotent close
requirements.text: Controller.Close shall be idempotent; repeated calls after the first shall return nil without error.

requirements.title: Closed send error
requirements.text: Controller.Send shall return ErrClosed after Controller.Close has been called.

requirements.title: Domain topic registration
requirements.text: Domain.NewTopic shall create and register a named Topic; subsequent NewTopic calls with the same name shall return the existing Topic.

requirements.title: DataWriter broadcast delivery
requirements.text: Topic.Write shall deliver the sample to all subscribed DataReaders without blocking the caller.

requirements.title: DataReader sample receipt
requirements.text: DataReader.Read shall yield a channel that receives samples written to the topic after the DataReader was created.

requirements.title: Bridge status publication
requirements.text: Bridge shall subscribe to the inner rcp.Controller's status channel and publish each rcp.Status sample to the DataWriter.

requirements.title: Bridge command dispatch
requirements.text: Bridge shall read *rcp.Command samples from the DataReader and invoke rcp.Controller.Send for each one.

requirements.title: Bridge close goroutines
requirements.text: Bridge.Close shall stop the status publisher and command dispatcher goroutines and wait for them to exit.

requirements.title: Bridge idempotent close
requirements.text: Bridge.Close shall be idempotent; repeated calls after the first shall return without error or panic.

requirements.title: Topic not found error
requirements.text: Domain.Lookup shall return ErrTopicNotFound when no topic with the requested name has been registered.
Broker routes PUBLISH messages to all matching subscribers on a topic.
Client.Publish delivers payload to all subscribers on the topic.
Client.Subscribe returns a channel that receives subsequent publishes to the topic.
Client.Unsubscribe removes the subscription so no further messages are delivered.
Bridge publishes encoded rcp.Status payloads to the configured status topic.
Bridge subscribes to the command topic and dispatches decoded rcp.Command via Controller.Send.
Client.Close unsubscribes from all topics idempotently.
Bridge.Close stops background goroutines and is idempotent.
EncodeFrame produces a valid 11-byte LIN frame with protected ID and classic checksum.
DecodeFrame parses an encoded frame back to the original ID, DataLen, and Data bytes.
DecodeFrame returns ErrChecksumMismatch when the checksum field is corrupted.
Bus.Send delivers frames to all Slaves registered for the matching frame ID.
Bus.Send does not deliver frames to Slaves registered for a different ID.
Slave receives frames dispatched by the Bus on its registered ID.
Bridge decodes LIN frames and dispatches them as rcp.Commands via Controller.Send.
Bridge.Close stops the dispatch goroutine and is idempotent.
BuildRequest produces a PDU with the correct SID, DID, and payload.
BuildPositiveResponse produces the correct response PDU with SID+0x40 prefix.
BuildNegativeResponse produces a 0x7F PDU with the echoed SID and NRC byte.
Server.Handle dispatches WriteDataByIdentifier (0x2E) PDUs to rcp.Controller.Send.
Server.Handle returns ErrNegativeResponse for unsupported service IDs.
Server.Handle(ReadDataByIdentifier, DIDRCPStatus) returns the current rcp.Status.
Server.Handle returns ErrPDUTooShort when the PDU is shorter than 3 bytes.
Server.Close prevents further Handle calls and is idempotent.
BuildHeader produces an 8-byte DoIP header with the correct protocol version and payload type.
ParseHeader reads and validates the DoIP header from an io.Reader.
ParseHeader returns ErrInvalidHeader for headers with incorrect version bytes.
Server.Serve accepts TCP connections and processes DiagMessage PDUs.
Client.Send transmits a diagnostic message and returns the UDS response payload.
Server returns a DiagMessageNack for unsupported payload types.
Server.Close stops the listener and is idempotent.
Client.Close closes the connection and is idempotent.
NewController returns a valid positive int32 handle for a new mock rcp.Controller.
RegisterController registers an externally-created rcp.Controller and returns a unique handle.
Send dispatches a command to the controller identified by handle and returns StatusOK on success.
Send returns ErrCodeInvalidHandle for handles that are not registered.
Subscribe opens a subscription on the controller and returns a positive subscription handle.
PollStatus returns ErrCodeNoData when no status event is immediately available.
PollStatus returns ErrCodeOK and a Status event after the controller publishes a status update.
Close deregisters the handle so subsequent Send calls return ErrCodeInvalidHandle.
StateSequence generates exactly n states starting from the initial state.
StateSequence applies the Generator at each step, producing correct intermediate states.
Always returns true when the predicate holds in every state of the trace.
Always returns false when the predicate fails in at least one state.
Eventually returns true when the predicate holds in at least one state of the trace.
Eventually returns false when the predicate holds in no state of the trace.
Until holds when predicate p holds continuously until predicate q becomes true.
Checker.Check returns ViolationError naming the first falsified invariant.
ComputeRisk returns the correct risk value as the product of impact and attack feasibility ratings.
ComputeRisk classifies risk values as Low (≤2), Medium (≤6), High (≤12), or Critical (>12).
ComputeRisk returns ErrInvalidRating when the impact rating is outside the 1–4 range.
ComputeRisk returns ErrInvalidRating when the feasibility rating is outside the 1–4 range.
ThreatScenario.RiskValue delegates to ComputeRisk using its own Impact and Feasibility fields.
TARA.HighRiskThreats returns only ThreatScenarios rated High or Critical.
GoalRegistry.Unsatisfied returns only CybersecurityGoals with Satisfied=false.
GoalRegistry.Unsatisfied returns an empty slice when all goals are satisfied.
Registry.Add registers a requirement so that All returns it.
Registry.SetMet marks a registered requirement as met, reflected in Analyze.
Registry.SetMet returns an error when the requirement ID is not registered.
Analyze returns Total=0 and ComplianceRatio=0 for an empty registry.
Analyze with empty targetASIL includes requirements of all ASIL levels.
Analyze with a specific targetASIL excludes requirements of other levels.
GapReport.ComplianceRatio equals MetCount divided by Total.
StandardASILDGaps returns exactly 8 predefined ASIL-D gap requirements.

requirements.title: ErrNotConnected is a non-nil mandatory RELAY sentinel
requirements.text: ErrNotConnected shall be a non-nil error such that errors.Is(ErrNotConnected, relay.ErrNotConnected) returns true. It is returned before a connection is established or after a transport drop.

requirements.title: ErrPayloadTooLarge is a non-nil mandatory RELAY sentinel
requirements.text: ErrPayloadTooLarge shall be a non-nil error such that errors.Is(ErrPayloadTooLarge, relay.ErrPayloadTooLarge) returns true. It is returned when a payload exceeds the protocol maximum.

requirements.title: ErrClosed wraps relay.ErrClosed via errors.Is chain
requirements.text: errors.Is(rcp.ErrClosed, relay.ErrClosed) shall return true so callers can use RELAY-level sentinel detection.

requirements.title: ErrNotConnected wraps relay.ErrNotConnected via errors.Is chain
requirements.text: errors.Is(rcp.ErrNotConnected, relay.ErrNotConnected) shall return true so callers can use RELAY-level sentinel detection.

requirements.title: ErrTimeout wraps relay.ErrTimeout via errors.Is chain
requirements.text: errors.Is(rcp.ErrTimeout, relay.ErrTimeout) shall return true so callers can use RELAY-level sentinel detection.

requirements.title: ErrPayloadTooLarge wraps relay.ErrPayloadTooLarge via errors.Is chain
requirements.text: errors.Is(rcp.ErrPayloadTooLarge, relay.ErrPayloadTooLarge) shall return true so callers can use RELAY-level sentinel detection.

requirements.title: ErrNotFound wraps ErrNotConnected via errors.Is chain
requirements.text: errors.Is(rcp.ErrNotFound, rcp.ErrNotConnected) shall return true per RELAY spec §5.4.

requirements.title: ErrAlreadyExists is standalone (not a relay sentinel)
requirements.text: ErrAlreadyExists shall be a standalone sentinel that does not wrap any relay sentinel, per RELAY spec §5.4. errors.Is(rcp.ErrAlreadyExists, rcp.ErrClosed) and errors.Is(rcp.ErrAlreadyExists, relay.ErrClosed) shall both return false; a uniqueness violation is not a relay sentinel condition.

requirements.title: ErrBusy wraps ErrTimeout via errors.Is chain
requirements.text: errors.Is(rcp.ErrBusy, rcp.ErrTimeout) shall return true per RELAY spec §5.4.

requirements.title: ErrZoneMismatch wraps ErrNotConnected via errors.Is chain
requirements.text: errors.Is(rcp.ErrZoneMismatch, rcp.ErrNotConnected) shall return true per RELAY spec §5.4.

requirements.title: SpecVersion exports the RELAY specification version
requirements.text: The package-level constant SpecVersion shall equal relay.SpecVersion, declaring the RELAY spec version this package implements per spec §17.12.

requirements.title: ZoneFromString parses zone name to Zone constant
requirements.text: ZoneFromString shall return the Zone constant matching the input string produced by Zone.String(), enabling round-trip zone identity.

requirements.title: ZoneFromString returns ErrNotFound for unknown zone string
requirements.text: ZoneFromString shall return (ZoneUnknown, ErrNotFound) when the input does not match any known zone name.

requirements.title: Status.ToMessage sets Protocol to relay.RCP
requirements.text: Status.ToMessage() shall return a relay.Message with Protocol = relay.RCP per RELAY spec §15.7.5.

requirements.title: Status.ToMessage maps Zone.String() to ID field
requirements.text: Status.ToMessage() shall set relay.Message.ID to the string returned by Status.Zone.String().

requirements.title: Status.ToMessage preserves Payload and Seq
requirements.text: Status.ToMessage() shall copy Status.Payload to relay.Message.Payload and Status.Seq (as uint64) to relay.Message.Seq.

requirements.title: Status.ToMessage sets rcp.healthy meta field
requirements.text: Status.ToMessage() shall set Meta["rcp.healthy"] to "true" or "false" reflecting Status.Healthy.

requirements.title: CommandFromMessage parses zone from relay.Message.ID
requirements.text: CommandFromMessage shall use ZoneFromString(m.ID) to set Command.Zone and return ErrNotFound for unrecognised zone strings.

requirements.title: CommandFromMessage parses rcp.priority from Meta
requirements.text: CommandFromMessage shall map Meta["rcp.priority"] to the corresponding Priority constant (normal/high/critical).

requirements.title: CommandFromMessage parses rcp.cmd_type from Meta
requirements.text: CommandFromMessage shall map Meta["rcp.cmd_type"] to the corresponding CommandType constant (noop/set/get/reset/watchdog/sleep/wake).

requirements.title: ResponseToMessage maps Response fields to relay.Message
requirements.text: ResponseToMessage shall set Protocol=relay.RCP, ID=Response.Zone.String(), Payload=Response.Payload, and Meta["rcp.status"] to the ResponseStatus decimal string.

requirements.title: Adapt wraps Controller as relay.Caller without blocking
requirements.text: Adapt(c Controller) relay.Caller shall return immediately, wrapping c in an adapter satisfying relay.Caller. It shall not establish a connection or block.

requirements.title: adapter.Protocol returns relay.RCP
requirements.text: The adapter returned by Adapt shall return relay.RCP from its Protocol() method.

requirements.title: adapter.Send converts relay.Message to Command and dispatches
requirements.text: adapter.Send shall call CommandFromMessage to convert the relay.Message to a *Command, dispatch it via Controller.Send, and discard the Response.

requirements.title: adapter.Call returns relay.Message from Response
requirements.text: adapter.Call shall call CommandFromMessage, dispatch via Controller.Send, and convert the *Response to relay.Message via ResponseToMessage.

requirements.title: adapter.Subscribe starts goroutine converting Status to relay.Message
requirements.text: adapter.Subscribe shall call Controller.Subscribe(context.Background()), start a goroutine that converts each *Status to relay.Message via ToMessage(), and return the relay.Message channel.

requirements.title: adapter.Subscribe applies SubscriberConfig channel depth
requirements.text: The channel buffered by adapter.Subscribe shall have depth equal to SubscriberConfig.ChanDepth(64).

requirements.title: adapter.Subscribe applies BackPressurePolicy
requirements.text: The goroutine in adapter.Subscribe shall apply the BackPressurePolicy from SubscriberConfig: DropNewest drops arriving messages when full; DropOldest drains one then enqueues; Block waits.

requirements.title: adapter.Close delegates to Controller.Close
requirements.text: adapter.Close() shall call and return the result of Controller.Close().

requirements.title: go-rcp version --format json emits VersionDocument
requirements.text: The go-rcp binary version command with --format json shall emit a JSON object conforming to RELAY spec §12.1 with tool, protocol, protocol_int, version, spec_version, language, and runtime fields.

requirements.title: go-rcp capabilities emits CapabilitiesDocument
requirements.text: The go-rcp binary capabilities command shall emit a JSON object conforming to RELAY spec §12.2 including kind, tool, protocol, commands, transports, features, interfaces, optional_interfaces, and adapt fields.

requirements.title: go-rcp status --format json emits StatusDocument
requirements.text: The go-rcp binary status command with --format json shall emit a JSON object conforming to RELAY spec §12.3 with protocol, tool, version, healthy, connected, endpoint, and details fields.

requirements.title: ServeBackground tracks Serve in WaitGroup before launching goroutine
requirements.text: ServeBackground() shall call wg.Add(1) synchronously before starting the Serve goroutine so that Close().wg.Wait() correctly blocks until Serve exits, avoiding data races on the WaitGroup.

requirements.title: Adapter implements relay.HealthProvider
requirements.text: The Adapt() result shall implement relay.HealthProvider, returning relay.Health from Health().

requirements.title: Health reflects closed and error state
requirements.text: Health() shall return HealthDown when the adapter is closed, HealthDegraded when errors have been recorded while open, and HealthOK otherwise.

requirements.title: Adapter implements relay.MetricsProvider
requirements.text: The Adapt() result shall implement relay.MetricsProvider, returning relay.Metrics from Metrics().

requirements.title: Metrics count writes, deliveries, drops, bytes and errors
requirements.text: Metrics() shall report WriteCount, DeliverCount, DropCount, BytesWritten, BytesDelivered and ErrorCount accumulated across Send, Call and Subscribe.

requirements.title: Adapter implements relay.Drainer
requirements.text: The Adapt() result shall implement relay.Drainer via CloseWithDrain(ctx).

requirements.title: CloseWithDrain waits for in-flight dispatches
requirements.text: CloseWithDrain shall block until in-flight Send/Call dispatches complete, then close; if ctx expires first it shall close immediately and return ctx.Err().

requirements.title: Status.ToMessage matches RELAY golden vector
requirements.text: Status.ToMessage() shall produce a relay.Message matching the published RELAY golden vector spec/vectors/rcp-status.json: protocol=RCP, id="FrontLeft", seq=3, meta[rcp.healthy]="true", payload base64 "AQ==", zero Version.

requirements.title: RELAY canonical schemas reachable
requirements.text: go-RCP shall build against a RELAY module exposing the §15 canonical-type JSON schemas (rcp-command, rcp-status) via relay.Schema(), confirming adoption of spec v0.3 artifacts.

requirements.title: SpecVersion sourced from RELAY module
requirements.text: The exported SpecVersion shall equal relay.SpecVersion (not hardcoded) and be non-empty, per spec §17.12/§19.4.

requirements.title: Concurrent publish and subscriber close never panic
